description: Updates family grouping for one saved own patent, using public patent information and related own patents already saved in the connected organisation. Useful for an apparent missing relationship, an unfinished family update, or a check against newer public information. Imports already attempt family grouping. Related publications are included only after they are imported. Existing relationships are retained, so a refresh cannot remove an incorrect one. Patent text, PDFs, images, legal status and own/competitor classification are unchanged. Competitor records are not supported. Returns counts of added and existing relationships, unresolved or ambiguous matches, and failures, with warnings; it returns no list of family members and does not establish complete family coverage. A null links result means the update did not finish; repeating the refresh attempts it again. A refresh can cost credits (see get_credits) and is refused once credits are spent.

documentId.description: Saved own patent document ID from import_patent, or document:<id> from search
